segments.he: ״כִּתְבוּ וּתְנוּ גֵּט לְאִשְׁתִּי, אִם לֹא בָּאתִי מִכָּאן וְעַד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ״ – כָּתְבוּ כּוּ׳.
segments.en: § The mishna states that if a husband says to others: «Write and give a bill of divorce to my wife if I do not come» back «from now until» the conclusion of «twelve months,» and «they wrote» it within the twelve months but gave it to her after twelve months, it is not a valid bill of divorce. Rabbi Yosei disagrees and says: It is a valid bill of divorce.
